idea: Autonomous 3-Way Invoice Reconciliation Agent for mid-market manufacturing companies that matches Purchase Orders, Goods Received Notes (GRN), and vendor invoices, flagging line-item price creep.

competitors.name: Vic.ai
weaknesses: Weak 3-way matching with physical warehouse GRN slips

competitors.name: Airbase
weaknesses: Aimed at tech startups, not industrial manufacturing

trends: Mid-market finance teams face 20% invoice dispute rates due to supply chain inflation
Shift towards continuous audit and real-time ERP reconciliation
ERP migration to cloud systems (NetSuite, SAP Business One, Acumatica)
risks: Accounting liability for false duplicate payment approvals
Noisy optical character recognition on degraded paper warehouse delivery notes
Complex custom multi-subsidiary GL account structures in ERPs

prd.problem_statement: Mid-market manufacturing accounting teams spend 240+ staff hours monthly manually comparing paper warehouse receipts, POs, and vendor PDF invoices to catch supplier price discrepancies.

personas.name: Elena Rostova
pain_points: Catches supplier pricing overcharges months after payment
goals: 100% automated 3-way match before check run approval

personas.name: Tom Bradley
pain_points: Manual line-by-line data entry from scanned PDFs
goals: Zero manual data entry on standard recurring suppliers

features.name: Line-Item Fuzzy Match Engine
features.description: Tolerates unit of measure differences (e.g. box vs unit) and validates line prices.

features.name: ERP Sync Connector (NetSuite / QuickBooks Online)
features.description: Two-way transaction synchronization and automated bill creation.

features.name: Variance Alerting & Vendor Dispute Drafts
features.description: Drafts polite vendor credit request emails whenever variance exceeds $50.

features.name: Audit Trail Export (CSV & PDF)
features.description: One-click export of matching evidence for external financial auditors.

prd.mvp_scope: Support NetSuite and QuickBooks Online with PDF invoice and scanned GRN ingestion within 8 weeks using 2 developers.
user_stories: As an AP specialist, I want scanned bills automatically paired with open POs so I don't type line items.
As a controller, I want price creep flagged above 2% so we stop vendor overcharges before paying.
As an auditor, I want timestamped matching proof so SOX compliance reviews take hours instead of weeks.
success_metrics: Match accuracy > 99.2% on standard purchase orders
AP processing cycle time reduced from 9 days to 24 hours
Discovered vendor overcharges average $14,000 / month per customer

stack.justification: Robust asynchronous document processing worker pipeline
Relational integrity for ledger lines and financial audit logs
Highest benchmark accuracy on tabular multi-page invoices
Asynchronous batch document ingestion and webhook callbacks
Side-by-side document highlight and dispute resolution interface

architecture.diagram_mermaid:
graph TD
  Invoice[Vendor PDF] --> Ingest[FastAPI Ingest API]
  Ingest --> Queue[Redis Task Queue]
  Queue --> OCR[Azure Document Intelligence]
  OCR --> Matcher[3-Way Reconciliation Engine]
  Matcher --> ERP[(NetSuite / QBO API)]
  Matcher --> DB[(Supabase Postgres)]
  Matcher --> Alert[Slack / Email Dispute Alert]
risks: Foreign exchange currency conversion fluctuations on international invoices
ERP rate limits during monthly close periods
Multi-page invoices spanning across PDF breaks
